View Test Case
Preconditions
TC-CAPCHECK-AMD-01 passed. A fresh V1 Search + FareConfirm for the same passenger-type mix as this case (offer id + fareConfirmResponseId in date). Staging only; accepted Hold/Book cases leave a live Amadeus PNR (CancelAfterHold is not supported for Amadeus).
Steps
  1. 1. POST V1 api/FlightSearch/Search (Amadeus/EGY, ADT+INF). 2. POST V1 api/FlightSearch/FareConfirm (searchResponseId + selectedOfferId). 3. POST V1 api/FlightBooking/Hold with the Test Data passengersList. 4. Repeat step 3 on V1 api/FlightBooking/Book with the identical passengersList and the same fareConfirmResponseId/selectedOfferId. 5. Record HTTP status, ErrorCode, ErrorMessage, Context[], pnr/gdsPNR/bookingToken and elapsed time.
Expected Result
Hold and Book both HTTP 200 with pnr/gdsPNR/bookingToken; passengersList echoes Mostafa/Ibrahim (ADT) and Lina/Ibrahim (INF) untruncated (the supplier layer upper-cases); Book additionally issues tickets. No NDC-INT-TEC-A0001.
Actual Result
Hold: echo: INF "Lina"/"Ibrahim" not echoed identically | Book: expected 200+pnr, got 500 ServerError Unknown error occured. Please keep the transaction id as a reference.

View Test Case
Preconditions
TC-CAPCHECK-AMD-01 passed. A fresh V1 Search + FareConfirm for the same passenger-type mix as this case (offer id + fareConfirmResponseId in date). Staging only; accepted Hold/Book cases leave a live Amadeus PNR (CancelAfterHold is not supported for Amadeus).
Steps
  1. 1. POST V1 api/FlightSearch/Search (Amadeus/EGY, ADT+ADT+ADT+CHD+INF+INF). 2. POST V1 api/FlightSearch/FareConfirm (searchResponseId + selectedOfferId). 3. POST V1 api/FlightBooking/Hold with the Test Data passengersList. 4. Record HTTP status, ErrorCode, ErrorMessage, Context[], pnr/gdsPNR/bookingToken and elapsed time.
Expected Result
HTTP 200 with pnr; all six passengers echoed untruncated. Each pair is 51 + 8 = 59 (the limit, inclusive); the third ADT (25/25, no infant) and the CHD (25/25) are not part of any pair sum.
Actual Result

This total includes the first name, last name, title, passenger type code (ADT/CHD). Delimiters and spaces are also counted in the total length. Please shorten the names or remove optional details to proceed.

Repeat step 3 on V1 api/FlightBooking/Book with the identical passengersList and the same fareConfirmResponseId/selectedOfferId. 5. Repeat step 3 on V1 api/FlightBooking/Book with the identical passengersList and the same fareConfirmResponseId/selectedOfferId. 5. View Test Case
Preconditions
TC-CAPCHECK-AMD-01 passed. A fresh V1 Search + FareConfirm for the same passenger-type mix as this case (offer id + fareConfirmResponseId in date). Staging only; accepted Hold/Book cases leave a live Amadeus PNR (CancelAfterHold is not supported for Amadeus).
Steps
  1. 1. POST V1 api/FlightSearch/Search (Amadeus/EGY, ADT+CHD). 2. POST V1 api/FlightSearch/FareConfirm (searchResponseId + selectedOfferId). 3. POST V1 api/FlightBooking/Hold with the Test Data passengersList. 4. Repeat step 3 on V1 api/FlightBooking/Book with the identical passengersList and the same fareConfirmResponseId/selectedOfferId. 5. Record HTTP status, ErrorCode, ErrorMessage, Context[], pnr/gdsPNR/bookingToken and elapsed time.
Expected Result
HTTP 400, ErrorCode NDC-INT-TEC-A0001, ErrorMessage "Invalid request. Please check the request parameters and try again."; "<first>: n | <last> : m => a first name or last name exceeds the maximum allowed limit of 25 characters by Amadeus support team." entry for the CHD; no pnr/gdsPNR/bookingToken is returned and nothing is created at the supplier (rejection is pre-supplier, sub-second).

View Test Case
Preconditions
TC-CAPCHECK-AMD-01 passed. A fresh V1 Search + FareConfirm for the same passenger-type mix as this case (offer id + fareConfirmResponseId in date). Staging only; accepted Hold/Book cases leave a live Amadeus PNR (CancelAfterHold is not supported for Amadeus).
Steps
  1. 1. POST V1 api/FlightSearch/Search (Amadeus/EGY, ADT). 2. POST V1 api/FlightSearch/FareConfirm (searchResponseId + selectedOfferId). 3. POST V1 api/FlightBooking/Hold with the Test Data passengersList. 4. Repeat step 3 on V1 api/FlightBooking/Book with the identical passengersList and the same fareConfirmResponseId/selectedOfferId. 5. Record HTTP status, ErrorCode, ErrorMessage, Context[], pnr/gdsPNR/bookingToken and elapsed time.
Expected Result
HTTP 400, ErrorCode NDC-INT-TEC-A0001, ErrorMessage "Invalid request. Please check the request parameters and try again."; "<first>: n | <last> : m => a first name or last name exceeds the maximum allowed limit of 25 characters by Amadeus support team." entry present; no pnr/gdsPNR/bookingToken is returned and nothing is created at the supplier (rejection is pre-supplier, sub-second); the response body stays small (does not echo the 1,000-character name more than once per Context entry).

Hold 400 A0001, 1 name entry, 0.1s; Book 400 A0001, 1 name entry, 0.1s

View Test Case
Preconditions
TC-CAPCHECK-AMD-01 passed. A fresh V1 Search + FareConfirm for the same passenger-type mix as this case (offer id + fareConfirmResponseId in date). Staging only; accepted Hold/Book cases leave a live Amadeus PNR (CancelAfterHold is not supported for Amadeus).
Steps
  1. 1. POST V1 api/FlightSearch/Search (Amadeus/EGY, ADT). 2. POST V1 api/FlightSearch/FareConfirm (searchResponseId + selectedOfferId). 3. POST V1 api/FlightBooking/Hold with the Test Data passengersList. 4. Record HTTP status, ErrorCode, ErrorMessage, Context[], pnr/gdsPNR/bookingToken and elapsed time.
Expected Result
HTTP 200 with pnr. Rule R2 is stated for an Adult and Infant pair; an ADT with no infant is not subject to it.
Actual Result
Hold: expected 200+pnr, got 400 NDC-INT-TEC-A0001 The passenger information for ADT 'Firstabcdefghijklmnopqrst MRS/Lastabcdefghijklmnopqrstu(ADT)' totals 56 characters + Space and Delimiters'/)(' length 4 , exceeding the maximum allowed limit of 59 characters set by Amadeus. This total includes the first name, last name, title, passenger type code (ADT/CHD). Delimiters and spaces are also counted in the total length. Please shorten the names or remove optional details to proceed.

Response: Hold: 200 pnr 7INSRD (7.6s)

Preconditions
TC-CAPCHECK-AMD-01 passed. A fresh V1 Search + FareConfirm for the same passenger-type mix as this case (offer id + fareConfirmResponseId in date). Staging only; accepted Hold/Book cases leave a live Amadeus PNR (CancelAfterHold is not supported for Amadeus).
Steps
  1. 1. POST V1 api/FlightSearch/Search (Amadeus/EGY, ADT+CHD+INF). 2. POST V1 api/FlightSearch/FareConfirm (searchResponseId + selectedOfferId). 3. POST V1 api/FlightBooking/Hold with the Test Data passengersList. 4. Record HTTP status, ErrorCode, ErrorMessage, Context[], pnr/gdsPNR/bookingToken and elapsed time.
Expected Result
HTTP 200 with pnr. Only the ADT and its linked INF are summed (51 + 8 = 59).
Actual Result
Hold: expected 200+pnr, got 400 NDC-INT-TEC-A0001 The passenger information for CHD 'Childabcdefghijklmnopqrst MISS/Minorabcdefghijklmnopqrst(CHD)' totals 57 characters + Space and Delimiters'/)(' length 4 , exceeding the maximum allowed limit of 59 characters set by Amadeus. This total includes the first name, last name, title, passenger type code (ADT/CHD). Delimiters and spaces are also counted in the total length. Please shorten the names or remove optional details to proceed.

Preconditions
TC-CAPCHECK-AMD-01 passed. A fresh V1 Search + FareConfirm for the same passenger-type mix as this case (offer id + fareConfirmResponseId in date). Staging only; accepted Hold/Book cases leave a live Amadeus PNR (CancelAfterHold is not supported for Amadeus).
Steps
  1. 1. POST V1 api/FlightSearch/Search (Amadeus/EGY, ADT+ADT+INF+INF). 2. POST V1 api/FlightSearch/FareConfirm (searchResponseId + selectedOfferId). 3. POST V1 api/FlightBooking/Hold with the Test Data passengersList. 4. Record HTTP status, ErrorCode, ErrorMessage, Context[], pnr/gdsPNR/bookingToken and elapsed time.
Expected Result
HTTP 200 with pnr; both pairs (51 + 8 = 59 each) accepted; the limit is per pair, not summed across the party.

Hold 200 pnr 7IM94A echoed untruncated

Preconditions
TC-CAPCHECK-AMD-01 passed. A fresh V1 Search + FareConfirm for the same passenger-type mix as this case (offer id + fareConfirmResponseId in date). Staging only; accepted Hold/Book cases leave a live Amadeus PNR (CancelAfterHold is not supported for Amadeus).
Steps
  1. 1. POST V1 api/FlightSearch/Search (Amadeus/EGY, ADT+ADT+INF). 2. POST V1 api/FlightSearch/FareConfirm (searchResponseId + selectedOfferId). 3. POST V1 api/FlightBooking/Hold with the Test Data passengersList. 4. Record HTTP status, ErrorCode, ErrorMessage, Context[], pnr/gdsPNR/bookingToken and elapsed time.
Expected Result
HTTP 200 with pnr; in the echoed passengersList the INF entry points at the passenger Ahmed/Hassan (the adult declared as ParentPaxRefId = Pax2).

View Test Case
Preconditions
TC-CAPCHECK-AMD-01 passed. A fresh V1 Search + FareConfirm for the same passenger-type mix as this case (offer id + fareConfirmResponseId in date). Staging only; accepted Hold/Book cases leave a live Amadeus PNR (CancelAfterHold is not supported for Amadeus).
Steps
  1. 1. POST V1 api/FlightSearch/Search (Amadeus/EGY, ADT). 2. POST V1 api/FlightSearch/FareConfirm (searchResponseId + selectedOfferId). 3. POST V1 api/FlightBooking/Hold with the Test Data passengersList. 4. Repeat step 3 on V1 api/FlightBooking/Book with the identical passengersList and the same fareConfirmResponseId/selectedOfferId. 5. Record HTTP status, ErrorCode, ErrorMessage, Context[], pnr/gdsPNR/bookingToken and elapsed time.
Expected Result
HTTP 400, ErrorCode NDC-INT-TEC-A0001, ErrorMessage "Invalid request. Please check the request parameters and try again."; the body contains none of: supplierRequest, supplierResponse, OriginalSupplierRequest/Response, password, Authorization, Bearer, x-api-key, stack-trace lines, .NET/Java type names.
Actual Result
No leak tokens in the Hold 360-byte / Book 360-byte error body (keys: Status,TransactionId,ErrorCode,ErrorMessage,Context)
Findings6Defects7Unknown-resolution
Defect
BUG-01: V1 Book returns HTTP 500 ServerError for a valid ADT-only passenger on Amadeus/EGY (3 of 3 Book calls: POS-01, BND-13, POS-06), while the identical request on Hold returns 200 with a PNR. (§2.9; §2.10; §2.5; Amadeus name rules (requirement text), TC-PAXNAME-POS-06)
Field: HTTP status / ErrorCode (V1 Book)
Expected value: 200 with pnr, gdsPNR, bookingToken and tickets[]
Impact: Book is unusable for Amadeus/EGY on this build, and because the 500 is generic (no Context, ~7.5 s like a Hold) it cannot be told whether a PNR/ticket was created at Amadeus; Retrieve is also unusable (HTTP 500), so a possibly orphaned booking cannot be checked.
Evidence: POS-06 Book ADT Mostafa/Ibrahim -> 500 {"ErrorCode":"ServerError","ErrorMessage":"Unknown error occured. Please keep the transaction id as a reference.","Context":[]} in 7-8 s; same names on Hold -> 200 pnr.
Defect
BUG-02: An infant that has the same surname as its adult is missing from the echoed passengersList (Hold 200); with a different surname the infant is echoed. (§2.9; §2.10; §2.5; Amadeus name rules (requirement text), TC-PAXNAME-BIZ-17)
Field: passengersList (Hold response)
Expected value: passengersList contains both "2-ADT" MOSTAFA/IBRAHIM and an INF entry LINA/IBRAHIM linked to it
Impact: Same-surname family bookings are the common case; the response gives no sign the infant is on the booking, and Retrieve is unusable on Amadeus (HTTP 500), so the infant cannot be verified. If the infant is truly not on the PNR the traveller has no infant record/ticket.
Evidence: ADT Mostafa/Ibrahim + INF Lina/Ibrahim -> echo only 2-ADT (POS-01, POS-03, POS-04, BIZ-17, probe P1); ADT Mostafa/Ibrahim + INF Lina/Hassan -> echo 2-ADT and 2-INF (BIZ-18, probe P2). POS-04 lost BOTH infants (Ibrahim and Hassan families).
Defect
BUG-03: ParentPaxRefId is ignored when the request goes to Amadeus: an infant declared under Pax2 is attached to the first adult; the combined-length pre-check still pairs by the declared parent, so valid-by-validation bookings fail at the supplier. (§2.9; §2.10; §2.5; Amadeus name rules (requirement text), TC-PAXNAME-BIZ-19)
Field: passengersList[INF].parentPaxRefId
Expected value: INF Lina/Zaki attached to Ahmed/Hassan (ParentPaxRefId = Pax2)
Impact: The infant is recorded under the wrong adult (wrong ticket/travel record), and a request that passes the 59-character pre-check can be rejected by Amadeus with an unmapped 409 Z9999 "ITEM TOO LONG / NOT ENTERED" (BIZ-04, BIZ-20) because the real pairing differs from the validated one.
Evidence: BIZ-19: Pax1 Mostafa/Ibrahim, Pax2 Ahmed/Hassan, INF Lina/Zaki parent Pax2 -> echo INF parentPaxRefId = 2-ADT (Mostafa). BIZ-20: Pax1 20/20 long adult, Pax2 short, INF parent Pax2 -> 409 Z9999 "FIRSTABC..MR LASTABC.. => ITEM TOO LONG" (the long first adult was paired with the infant).
Defect
BUG-04: The first-name length reported in the 25-character message includes the title (26-character first name + Mr is reported as 28) while the last-name figure is the raw length; the limit itself is applied to the raw name. (§2.9; §2.10; §2.5; Amadeus name rules (requirement text), TC-PAXNAME-VAL-19)
Field: Context[].Value (25-character message)
Expected value: "Firstabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvw: 26 | Lastnm : 9 => ..." (raw lengths)
Impact: Diagnostic only, but the reported 28 contradicts the 25-character limit text and misleads whoever shortens the name (a 24-character first name is accepted although the message logic would report 26).
Evidence: First name 26 chars + title Mr -> "...: 28 | <last> : 9". The stakeholder sample ("ChristopherAlexanderMaxMost: 29") shows the same title-inclusive figure for a 27-character name.
Defect
BUG-05: Request-binding validation errors (invalid title value, missing name, null list ...) use a second, different error envelope (camelCase keys, errorCode "1001", a spurious "holdRequestDto field is required" entry) and expose the internal .NET type NDC.Integrations.Application.Dtos.Api.Title; name-rule errors use the PascalCase NDC-INT-TEC-A0001 envelope. (§2.9; §2.10; §2.5; Amadeus name rules (requirement text), TC-PAXNAME-BIZ-13)
Field: error envelope (model-binding validation errors)
Expected value: One envelope: {Status, TransactionId, ErrorCode:"NDC-INT-TEC-A0001", ErrorMessage, Context[{Value}]} and no internal type names
Impact: Clients must parse two shapes for the same endpoint, and internal class names are disclosed. Also the title domain is an undocumented enum, so a long/unknown title cannot reach the length rule.
Evidence: Hold with a 20-character title -> 400 {"status":400,"errorCode":"1001","errorMessage":"Validation errors occurred. Please check your request.","context":[{"name":"holdRequestDto","value":"The holdRequestDto field is required."},{"name":"$.passengersList.Pax1.title","value":"The JSON value could not be converted to NDC.Integrations.Application.Dtos.Api.Title. ..."}],"originalSupplierRequest":null,"originalSupplierResponse":null}. NEG-01..NEG-16 return the same 1001 envelope.
Defect
BUG-06: Non-ASCII letters (Arabic, accented Latin) and some pairings pass the integration name pre-check, are rejected by Amadeus, and surface as an unmapped HTTP 409 NDC-INT-UNC-Z9999 whose body carries the raw supplier SOAP request (including the Amadeus Security header UserID/OfficeId) and response. (§2.9; §2.10; §2.5; Amadeus name rules (requirement text), TC-PAXNAME-VAL-09)
Field: ErrorCode / OriginalSupplierRequest (supplier-side name rejection)
Expected value: 400 NDC-INT-TEC-A0001 "...must only contain letters and spaces (A-Z)" with no OriginalSupplierRequest/Response
Impact: Legitimate names such as Jose/Muller cannot be booked and the failure is reported as an unmapped supplier error; every Z9999 409 leaks supplier request/response and account identifiers (tracked leak class, §7.14).
Evidence: VAL-09 (Arabic first name) and VAL-11 (José / Müller) -> 409 Z9999 "18|Presentation|Serializing/Deserializing error: [type = DataElement] [name = firstName|surname] [Error = Wrong data format (an, n, etc)]"; BIZ-04/BIZ-20 -> 409 Z9999 "ITEM TOO LONG / NOT ENTERED". Bodies contain OriginalSupplierRequest/Response (redacted in this log).
Unknown-resolution
The 59-character limit is not only an ADT+INF pair rule: a single ADT or CHD is also checked ("The passenger information for CHD ... totals N characters + Space and Delimiters length 4 ..."): first+title+last+PTC+4 <= 59. A CHD with 25/25 names (57+4) and an ADT with 25/25 names and title Mrs (56+4) are rejected; 25/25 with Mr (55+4 = 59) and a CHD at 24/24 are accepted (BND-05, BND-22), 24/25 is rejected (BND-23). (TC-PAXNAME-POS-05)
Unknown-resolution
Names accept letters and spaces only: hyphens (Al-Mansour), apostrophes (O'Connor), digits, "/", parentheses, tabs/newlines, emoji and decomposed accents are rejected with 400 A0001 "Name.<field> '<value>' must only contain letters and spaces." Leading/trailing spaces are counted, not trimmed (26 raw characters reported as 28). (TC-PAXNAME-VAL-03)
Unknown-resolution
title is an enumerated value (NDC.Integrations.Application.Dtos.Api.Title); an unknown value is rejected at model binding. The title is checked against gender ("Title MRS does not match Gender Male"), and the title counts toward the combined length (Mrs +1 and MSTR +2 versus Mr/MS push a 59 pair over: BND-19, BND-20; Mrs on names summing 40 lands exactly on 59 and is accepted: BND-18). (TC-PAXNAME-BIZ-13)
Unknown-resolution
Middle name is not length-checked and not part of the combined sum: a 30-character middle name (BIZ-12) and an 11-character adult middle name on a 59 pair (BIZ-09) are accepted. (TC-PAXNAME-BIZ-12)
Unknown-resolution
Amadeus/EGY on ne-8: Hold works (200, ~7 s), but CancelAfterHold returns 409 OperationNotSupported ("Amadeus does not exists"), Retrieve returns 500 ServerError, and Book returns 500 (BUG-01). Held PNRs therefore cannot be released or inspected through this API; they are listed under Cleanup. (TC-PAXNAME-POS-01)
Unknown-resolution
Transient supplier error: the first attempt of VAL-17 (25-character lowercase first name) returned HTTP 409 Z9999 "55|Application|IGNORE AND RE-ENTER" on a fresh offer; four immediate retries (probes P3, P4, P5 and the VAL-17 re-run) returned 200. That first-attempt result was replaced by the passing retry in this log. (TC-PAXNAME-VAL-17)
Unknown-resolution
Combined-length semantics confirmed live: 51 name+title+PTC characters plus 8 delimiters = 59 is accepted, 52 is rejected (BND-13/BND-15); the message "totals N" excludes the delimiters; the stakeholder sample reproduces character for character, including "ChristopherAlexanderMaxMost: 29" for a 27-character first name (title counted). (TC-PAXNAME-REG-01)
Proposed SPEC.md updates2Proposed Updates

§2.5 — status: pending

Old: "- Every `INF` passenger must carry a valid `ParentPaxRefId` pointing to an `ADT` entry present in the same request."

New: "- Every `INF` passenger must carry a valid `ParentPaxRefId` pointing to an `ADT` entry present in the same request. - Amadeus name rules (live-confirmed 2026-10-29, V1 Book/Hold, ne-8, Amadeus/EGY): `name.first` and `name.last` each at most 25 characters; the passenger string `<first> <TITLE>/<last>(<PTC>)` must be at most 59 characters including delimiters (ADT or CHD alone: first+title+last+3 plus 4 delimiters; ADT with INF: both strings plus 8 delimiters); names accept letters and spaces only (no hyphen, apostrophe, digits); `title` is an enumerated value checked against `gender`. Violations return 400 `NDC-INT-TEC-A0001` with the reason in `Context[].Value`."

Correction: Confirmed by TC-PAXNAME-BND-*, VAL-* and POS-05; product should confirm the stricter-than-stated parts (single ADT/CHD limit, letters-only).
